label: Constitutive receipt and component-level positive existential import
summary: PR #1969 checkpoint C, note docs/notes/unique-feedback-explanation-311.md, continuation from b0c8d2b37105566fad7206cd5c63806a1b278626. A strictly productive receipt constitutively requires an exercised giver; existence of a bearer by that receipt in alternative realizations and potential closure of all such suppliers in C are separate open bridges. For arbitrary admissible input/output relation D on subsets of the actual roster, the component guard G (C-free input implies C-free allowed output) and a joint retained realization J (at U=A minus C there is an output containing U) imply D(U,U), since that output must equal U. Under G, J is equivalent to D(U,U); warrant needs a genuinely retained joint productive witness, not a restatement. For C=A, J is existence of an output at empty input. For a proper component, a retained realization must supply every member of U together. A varying-supplier nonmonotone finite control meets the weaker guard while violating the fixed actual supplier menu and monotonicity. Earlier monotone proof can find a proper survivor when J for U fails; sufficient packages are not generally ordered. Individually available outputs do not imply jointly available outputs: exhaustive Python diagnostic over all nonempty families of subsets of one to three retained members; at size three 90 of 218 covering families omit full U, while all 128 directed covering families contain U. Infinite finite-subsets family separates finite joint coverage from full realization. A reused strict successor-chain equation with necessary identity-fixed suppliers under a stipulated two-world frame shows the purely modal and relational conditions do not entail a root; modal non-deletion holds throughout that frame. The all-absent solution satisfies the same local equations outside the frame. Guarded receipt and source-triggered laws alone lack positive existential import on an otherwise admissible empty component. Non-deletion is not justified for all contingent effects; nonnecessitating actual explanation should instead explain availability of productive input. Source-relative explanatory advantage at the received-effect scope is conditional on genuine nonreceived availability and productive exercise; a brute necessary source incurs the same burden for its own actuality. No new registered proof or change to the prior scoped provisional assessment. Earlier checkpoint finite enumeration reproduced exactly; preceding CI 45509404715 succeeded and reported no premise change, with NanoDa and result shards skipped. Unreviewed continuation on baseline 1d84cb4b461b7a0aa8c1b6219b92556497c61bd7, note section “Can the instantiated whole explain why there are actual givings in this series?” Fernández-Nieves et al. (2007), Figs. 1 and 3, and Han et al. (2024), Figs. 1, 4–5 and discussion, distinguish the constraint on total surface index from observed counts and inferred signs. This is positive warrant for token-independent local existential explanation from an instantiated state. The actual closed series still needs a ground for the global activity obtaining or a parity-consistent primitive stop. Compared with the #1097 replacement certificate, #1966, the duet and the same-B scope of open #1968 at c4418c40981bf8f04e41e161580102ddc266d70d. No formal premise change.
blocker: A global activity can require local exercises without fixing their bearers. What warrants its obtaining and explanatory independence from the joint occurrence of the receipts in this very cone? Neither the shell conditions nor the replacement certificate supply that existential bridge. Essential reception across alternatives, potential closure and joint retention remain open where the deletion argument uses them.

current_assessment.scope: A supplier-closed series and the existential import of a whole across replacement of its members.
current_assessment.assessment: The two-world rootless chain retains every bearer at every accessible world. The local equations alone also admit an empty chain. To retain the complement of a deleted proper component, one admissible realization must sustain all its retained members together. The modest preference for an unreceived giver depends on the further judgment that wholly received givings require such a source. The shell explains why some defect must occur without presupposing a particular defect. For a supplier cone, dispensing with a particular giver leaves open whether the proposed whole borrows their joint actuality. Both accounts may defend a primitive stopping point at the inclusive scope.
current_assessment.next_test: For this actual supplier cone, specify the global condition claimed to require an exercise there across replacements. Which otherwise populated distribution does its character rule out? Test whether its obtaining is primitive, whether a received constituent grounds it, or whether its realizer actually gives without receiving. Apply the same stopping rule and exercise test to the proposed source.
current_assessment.evidence: Independent review of checkpoints A–D at cc4499f39f6a57ebc98ac80b8709c60729cc1f1d reproduced all four executable comparisons. Targeted review accepted the modal, joint-retention, whole-first, and comparative-warrant corrections at 7e50b076da6fca5837ba3497f5ac77da731f937a. The duet has its own reviewed disposition. PR-1969. That review covers the earlier work. Independent challenge at 16ed6affce5622434797be46d35c26acb8bfb39a accepted the per-interface index constraint, the distinction between imaged and inferred defects, and the distinction between explaining some local receipt and accounting for their joint occurrence. It confirmed the stated assumptions and witness of commonSourceOfClosed. The comparative preference is confined to exhaustive productive supply reaching the selected recipient.
